site.survey: DLTC/TIITYS turning-movement counts, weekday AM/PM peak, KalindiKunj + Okhla Head approach video surveys
site.summary: Two-way Yamuna crossing with a three-to-two lane reduction at each portal; the kerb lane is dropped on the deck, so a slow heavy vehicle blocks an entire approach and pushes the queue back across the signalised junction at Okhla Head.
